author: From Staff Reports
title: GIRLS BASKETBALL ROUNDUP: Seckinger's Alaina Johnson reaches 1,000 career points - NewsBreak
text:
By From Staff Reports ,
6 hours ago BUFORD — Alaina Johnson celebrated reaching 1,000 career points in the Seckinger girls basketball team’s 59-42 win over Johns Creek in Region 7- on Wednesday.
Johnson finished with 19 points and five steals, while Nalani Gainey had another strong all-around game with 20 points, eight assists, eight rebounds and seven steals.
The Jaguars also got solid games from Jaasiel Maria (six points, three assists), Janyla Reed (five points, five blocks, four rebounds, two assists, two steals) and Trinity Robinson (five points).
GIRLS BASKETBALL
Archer 57, South Gwinnett 47
LAWRENCEVILLE — Region-leading Archer downed South Gwinnett 57-47 in 4- on Wednesday.
Braalyn Whitehead (15 points) and Saniya Sharper (14 points) led the Tigers (18-5, 8-1) in scoring, while Hailey Houlder added seven points.
Parkview 59, Berkmar 6
LILBURN — Parkview dispatched neighboring Berkmar 59-6 in 7- on Wednesday.
Maddison Merrick shined for the Panthers with 22 points. She was backed up by Corrin Sevier (eight points, four assists) and Baileigh Paige (nine points, four steals, three assists).
North Gwinnett 44, Duluth 34
SUWANEE — Elle Ambrosi scored 15 points Wednesday as North Gwinnett downed Duluth 44-34 in 7- .
Duluth was paced by Kaylie Zirger’s 14 points.
Hebron 71, Franklin County 17
CARNESVILLE — Hebron Christian romped to a 71-17 win over Franklin County in 8-AA on Wednesday.
The Lions (21-1, 7-0) were led by Gabby Minus (11 points, five rebounds, two assists, two steals), Nariah Nelson (10 points, seven rebounds, four steals) and Taryn Dixon (10 points, seven rebounds, four steals).
Rabun County 66, Providence 46
TIGER — Providence Christian lost 66-46 at Rabun County in 8-A Division I on Wednesday.
Zoie Cameron scored 20 for the Storm.
